purpose: Use the leave-5 three-stage protocol of E197 (Train rejection vs Test S1 Spearman 0.85, bias -0.095) as the Train-only selector for the gate / fusion weights, then score Test exactly once. Candidate pool: E65 (PCA-96, k=12), subwin6, subwin12, logbp, E162 embedding; wccn_dr is excluded because E197 showed it collapses (0.9925 -> 0.3298) once the enrolment set shrinks; E183 is not part of the requested pool. All pairs and triples on the 0.1 simplex grid are enumerated.

protocol.stage1_training: all 20 identities, fit rows (frac <= 0.6): task-wise mean/sd, PCA basis, E162 encoder frozen. Fold-invariant, computed once.
protocol.stage2_enrolment: prototypes of the 15 enrolled identities only, from their own fit rows; k_proto = 12 for e65_dist, 1 for the other four streams
protocol.stage3_deployment: argmax identification over the enrolled prototypes + threshold rejection; tau = quantile(enrolled known best-match scores, 1 - a)
protocol.score_normalisation: each stream is divided by the mean/sd of its all-20 best-match score on the evaluation window (queries are disjoint from the prototype rows, so no self-inclusion); the same constants are used for the leave-5 folds, the strict LOSO folds and Test, so the fusion weights are fixed standardised units
protocol.test_threshold: tau = quantile(concatenated loso_strict known best-match scores, 1 - a) - Train only, E195 'paired' rule

test_readings.deployment: gallery = all 20 registered identities, tau = paired loso_strict quantile; this is the reading behind #9 / #10 and the PGD chain
test_readings.fold_matched: gallery = the fold's 15 enrolled identities, tau = that fold's enrolled known quantile, averaged over the 200 leave-5 folds; this is the reading comparable with E197's rej5

fusion_grid.note: pairs use 0.0-1.0 in 0.1 steps, triples walk the simplex with 0.1 steps; every component stream is z-standardised before the weighted sum

selection.rule: R1: acc5 >= 0.95 AND loso_strict > 0.90; then maximise rej5; tie-break higher auc5
selection.fallback: R1': if the R1 set is empty on Train (verified before any Test scoring), drop #11 and keep acc5 >= 0.95, then maximise rej5, tie-break auc5; the #11 failure is reported explicitly

metrics.rej5: mean over the 200 leave-5 folds of the unregistered rejection rate at a=0.90
metrics.acc5: mean over the same folds of the enrolled argmax identification accuracy
metrics.auc5: mean over the same folds of known-vs-unregistered AUROC (pooled AUROC reported for the top five)
metrics.loso_strict: mean over the 20 strict leave-1 LOSO folds of the unknown rejection rate at a=0.90
metrics.auroc5: pooled strict LOSO AUROC, the #5 reading

gates.1: Train in-sample accuracy = 1.00 (E191 branch-A v3 identity backbone)
gates.5: pseudo-unknown LOSO AUROC >= 0.98 (strict reading; std alongside)
gates.7: RA over the self-built PGD grid >= 0.95 (SNR30 primary, SNR20 reported)
gates.8: ASafeR over the same grid >= 0.98 (SNR30 primary, SNR20 reported)
gates.11: loso_strict unknown rejection at a=0.90 > 0.90 (loso_std alongside)

attack.type: self-built white-box PGD on the E191 branch-A v3 identity model
attack.subset: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, stratified cap 400 per task, seed 20261116
attack.radius: per-trial L2 norm of the channel-demeaned waveform divided by 10^(SNR/20)

reporting.test_official: N/A - Test has no identity labels; official AUC / F1 / C / RA / ASafeR / U / Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: all Test scores are computed before the Session column is read; Session only splits S1 / S2 for the #9 / #10 audit
reporting.compliance: selection uses Train only (leave-5 three-stage + strict LOSO); Test is scored once, after the top five are frozen
